description: This file contains a shell script used for testing the 'advise_if_enabled' functionality within a Git-related testing framework. It sets environment variables, sources a test library, and defines several test cases that verify whether advice messages are correctly printed or suppressed based on configuration variables.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified description and commands.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration variable for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_tool advise
methods.description: Runs the advice tool with the provided message to test advice printing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Defines cleanup actions to be run after tests.
